input_fields.name: viewport
input_fields.description: Maximized viewport and one cursor position over the model/empty viewport.

input_fields.name: wheel_steps
input_fields.description: One finite signed number of wheel steps and intended zoom direction.

input_fields.name: navigation_mapping
input_fields.description: Calibrated wheel-to-zoom direction and step behavior for the current navigation theme.

result_fields.name: zoomed_view
result_fields.description: Before/after apparent scale, cursor position, applied wheel steps, and geometry-unchanged observation.

procedure: Place the cursor at the declared viewport position and verify the active window is SpaceClaim.
Confirm the calibrated wheel direction and issue exactly one wheel action with wheel_steps.
Observe apparent scale and verify that the model itself was not edited; return zoomed_view.
If the direction or result differs from the mapping, stop with needs_manual_review.
rejection_rules: Reject a missing/zero/nonfinite step count, cursor outside the viewport, uncalibrated wheel behavior, or an unobservable result.
Do not use repeated wheel actions to compensate for an unknown mapping.
Do not treat a wheel event as proof of geometry change.
